name: Ca ro Tong Truong
summary: Cá rô Tổng Trường is the perch the tourism center’s family day, updated 3 August 2026, names with dê núi and cơm cháy at midday in Tam Coc, and calls a Ninh Bình specialty. The family day prints no restaurant and no method. Sở Du lịch Ninh Bình, 23 August 2021, says Tổng Trường is the old name of xã Trường Yên, huyện Hoa Lư, and names rang, rán, kho, and canh chua, and does not name Tam Coc. The 20 October 2023 culture office places the fish in thành phố Ninh Bình or the old capital. The tourism center’s Tet note, updated 12 February 2026, says kho tộ or rán giòn on a Ninh Bình Tet table, and names Tam Coc only as scenery. All of those sentences stay.
origin: Tổng Trường, the old name of xã Trường Yên in Hoa Lư, on the 23 August 2021 tourism-department page, and a midday name on the 3 August 2026 Tam Coc day.
howToEat: The 3 August 2026 Tam Coc day prints the name and no method. Check on arrival.

Sở Du lịch Ninh Bình, 23 August 2021, names rang, rán, kho, and canh chua, and describes canh chua with cá rô rán, pickled mustard greens, diluted nước dưa, tomato, and fried tofu. Sở Du lịch Ninh Bình does not name Tam Coc.
The 12 February 2026 Tet note says kho tộ or rán giòn, with hot rice, on a Ninh Bình Tet table. The Tet note does not name a Tam Coc restaurant.
where: Midday on the 3 August 2026 Tam Coc family day. No restaurant and no street. A clock hour beyond buổi trưa is Check on arrival.
Thành phố Ninh Bình or the old capital, on the 20 October 2023 culture office page. Cố đô Hoa Lư, on the 23 August 2021 tourism-department page.
